subject: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaron.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@stellaron.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising for our clinical analytics workload. Procurement has a handful of standard gating items before we can lock the committed discount tier:

- A signed PO with Stellaron's PO number in the invoice header (we need PO-id in the header for AP reconciliation)
- Net terms: our AP team prefers net45 but will accept net30 for certain vendors; need to confirm Redwood's flexibility
- Invoice cadence: we'd like weekly consolidated invoices for usage to line up with our internal remit runs; alternately, we can accept monthly statements if weekly is not available
- Invoice fields: billing entity, BU code, and a tax ID field on the invoice PDF

Can you send your standard PO template or confirm whether Redwood requires any special PO metadata? Also, is the discount conditioned on a committed monthly usage floor or is it tied to annual consumption?

I'll attach our PO template for reference (procurement@stellaron.com). If helpful, I can loop in our AP lead.

Thanks,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
Stellaron Therapeutics
liam.oconnor@stellaron.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaron.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount

Hi Liam — great to meet you yesterday. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below. I've attached a short summary of the discount tiers and our preferred PO fields.

Answers:
- PO header: we can accept Stellaron's PO number in the invoice header and will include it in our AP export. We prefer the PO to be placed in the top-right header field; any consistent header position is fine as long as the PO is machine-readable.
- Net terms: standard hosted customers default to net30, but for committed enterprise contracts we can agree net45 on a quarterly review cadence. For an up-front committed spend discount we can move to net60 for the first 60 days as a one-time concession — need approval from finance (cc'ing Ben).
- Invoice cadence: our billing engine can emit weekly consolidated usage invoices (CSV + PDF) but weekly increases the operational overhead and has a small surcharge. If weekly is required, we will note a line-item on invoices: "Weekly consolidation fee (if applicable)". Alternately, monthly consolidated statements are available at no additional charge.
- Invoice fields: we can add billing entity, BU code, and tax ID fields to the PDF and the CSV export for ERP mapping.

Next steps:
1) Liam: please send your PO template (you mentioned attaching it) so our billing ops can confirm the header placement.
2) Ben: could you confirm whether finance can approve net45 as default for this account and whether the one-time net60 concession is doable?
3) Vanessa: can you calculate a quick estimate of the weekly surcharge (if we enable weekly invoices) and add it to the discount summary?

I'll stand by for the PO template and will prepare the contract amendment language for the committed usage clause.

Best,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@stellaron.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaron.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount

Hi Neha / Ben,

Attached is Stellaron's standard PO template (Stellaron_PO_Template.pdf) and an internal note describing our remit window. A couple clarifications from AP:

- PO-id must appear in both the invoice header and the CSV file in a field named "PO_NUMBER" for our ERP mapping
- For weekly invoices we process payments on Friday afternoon; billing must close on Tuesday 23:59 ET to make that cycle
- The discount the commercial team approved was contingent on a committed minimum of $40k/month billable usage, evaluated quarterly

If Redwood can accept the PO fields and the cadence constraints above, we can proceed to legal to finalize an amendment.

Thanks,
Anna

--
Anna Ruiz
Procurement Specialist (AP)
Stellaron Therapeutics
anna.ruiz@stellaron.com
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount

Quick internal note — finance is open to net45 for committed enterprise deals, but:
- Net45 requires an explicit committal clause in the SOW with monthly usage floors (finance wants automated alerts if usage drops below threshold)
- One-time net60 concession needs VP of Finance sign-off; I'll loop Marcus if we want to offer that as an incentive

On weekly invoices: ops will charge a small operational fee (0.2% of invoice or minimum $150/week) to cover CSV generation & early cutoffs. Recommend we present both options to Stellaron with clear TCO examples.

If you want, I can draft the finance language and the two-option billing appendix.

—Ben
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaron.com>, Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@stellaron.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 16:43:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & PO requirements for enterprise discount

Hi Liam / Anna — thanks for the template and the clarity. Summarizing our agreed approach so procurement has a single doc to pass to legal: 

- PO: Redwood will accept Stellaron's PO template. Billing ops will map Stellaron_PO_Template.pdf fields to Redwood CSV schema; required field name "PO_NUMBER" will be emitted in both PDF and CSV.
- Net terms: Redwood will accept net45 for this committed enterprise agreement. The net45 term will be conditioned on a signed SOW that includes a committed monthly minimum of $40,000 billable usage, reviewed quarterly.
- Concession: the one-time net60 introductory concession is subject to VP Finance approval; Ben will confirm by next week if we can offer it as a formal signing incentive.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood can produce weekly consolidated invoices that close on Tuesday 23:59 ET for Stellaron's Friday payment run. Weekly invoices carry an operational fee (0.2% of invoice, min $150/week). Monthly consolidated statements are available without fee.

I've attached the Redwood_discount_summary_v1.pdf and a draft billing appendix that legal can fold into the contract amendment. If that looks right, Anna/Liam, please confirm and we will open the amendment in DocuSign (link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-stellaron).

Best,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
